verdict: Bounded diagnosis complete; no demonstrated new Loom transport defect. Original cost/quality failures remain, and current deployed native-final adoption is not accepted by this audit.

precisionMechanism.source: 4-current snapshot-6/invoice.py: _validate_rows multiplies before summarize enters localcontext; later higher precision cannot restore lost digits. Same observable failure reproduced in snapshots 6-12.

quality.warningInterpretation: Generated source contains non-raw docstring escapes. Under evaluator Python 3.13, SyntaxWarning violates generated tests requiring empty stderr. Appears on both sides; no evidence of model-tool interpreter version, so do not call evaluator false positive or attribute to Loom.
quality.independence: The precision issue persists across seven rounds in one session; warning failures persist across four-round clusters. These are not independent model failures.
quality.productBoundary: invoice.py and its tests are generated workload artifacts, not Loom backend source. No automatic product patch follows from these failures.

limits: Initial fixed-input delta does not isolate causal token effect across later stochastic trajectories.
Generation count includes every raw /messages response; auxiliary count_tokens requests remain separate.
Tool counts are calls, not generation counts; one generation may call several tools.
Original per-round correct flags in arms come from historical runner and do not replace lead current oracle replay correction above.
Compact UTF-8 JSON byte measures are diagnostic, not token estimates.
Raw CLI model resolves sonnet to claude-sonnet-5-5 with low effort; results apply to this fixed old cohort, not current five-CLI acceptance.
cost.causalLimit: More business tool generations and longer history are observed. This does not isolate why the model chose those paths or prove a backend defect.

entryRepair.status: Integrated into isolated copied real parent/guard with synthetic child; old paid batch remains unchanged
limits: No real Claude CLI, model, provider network, full mixed cohort or five-way actual contention in this bounded check.
Synthetic child declares normal session/memory/quality/cleanup gates; this is controller wiring evidence, not new verification of those provider properties.
Normal receipts are synthetic amounts; fault SSE is synthetic. No cost or efficiency inference.
Synthetic closure hashes cover local harness and required method; not a newly approved full paid closure.
30-second maximum remains finite and can fail under longer contention.
Original failed paid sample unchanged; no rerun or replacement.

decision.stop: Do not reopen transport/prompt optimization merely for the old 1.48 ratio. No new product bug was demonstrated here.
decision.retain: Actual excess spend and generated-artifact quality failures remain valid historical observations; no success reclassification.
decision.claudeCurrent: New mixed batch failed before model start. Old one-task results cannot prove current generic cost or quality. Any future verification uses a fixed cohort and distribution-based interpretation, not repeat-until-pass.
decision.backend: Core mechanisms have prior deterministic and real-CLI evidence. Finish requires a narrow current-path adoption and operational acceptance, not rebuilding every subsystem.
decision.nextPriority: Combine actual multi-instance parallelism, busy Human input and held recovery into one bounded vertical acceptance, then check session continuity and accounting labels at the chosen deployment scope.
decision.paidRunStatus: No new paid batch launched or frozen by this audit.
